messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: random site effects in occuTTD ?
parts:
Dear Ken,

does occuTTD support additional random effects through TMB ? I have a data set with multiple observations from the same set of sites and would ideally accommodate possible non-independence of the data from the same site by adding a site random effect, as in + (1 | site).

Thanks and best regards  --- Marc

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] random site effects in occuTTD ?
parts:
Hi Marc,

Unfortunately occuTTD does not yet support TMB/random effects. However you could try fitting the model in ubms with stan_occuTTD, which does allow random effects.

Ken
